jobs.title: Head Trader eFX Spot – Associate-Director
jobs.description:
As an Associate-Director in the FX & DA Trading department, you will be in charge of the eFX Spot team. Reporting directly to the Head Spot Vice-Director, you will supervise the operational activities and manage people in accordance with your senior management.
 Key responsibilities
 Team Management:

• Leading and supporting the eFX Spot team:
• Fostering a positive work atmosphere where employees feel motivated, valued, and connected to the team and the organization.

• Promoting collaboration, trust, and cohesion among team members.

• Addressing any potential conflicts among team members to your senior management and/or HR Partner

• Supporting employee growth through training, mentorship, coaching, and advancement opportunities.

• Hiring:
• Leading the recruitment process with your Talent Acquisition Partner

• Ensuring new hires are properly introduced to the team, the organization, its culture, policies, and their specific roles.

• Performance Management: Setting performance expectations, providing feedback, conducting performance reviews, and addressing any performance issues.

• Conducting under performance process with the help of your Senior Management and HR Partner.
 Operational duties:

• Own the realized risk and PnL

• Ensure successful and compliant operations
• Monitor orders, trades, overall market conditions, news flow, real-time risk and PnL

• Fine-tune price construction, execution and risk management production systems

• Monitor the overall client activity and ensure flow quality, as well as smooth client trading experience

• Maintain a gainful network of hedging counterparties and market venues

• Analyze results, identify and drive improvements

• Data analysis: Use internal analytical tools and your own quantitative capabilities to draw data-driven conclusions, suggest actions, deliver reporting

• Documentation: maintain up-to-date operational procedures and ensure compliance

• Collaborating: Be a reference point for Sales, Software Engineers, IT colleagues and other internal teams

• Project Management: Contribute to product development and infrastructure improvements

• Monitoring: team’s capacity allocation

• Minimum 8 years’ experience in sell-side electronic FX trading

• Previous experience in a leadership role is a strong advantage

• Deep understanding of market (micro)structure

• Deep understanding of client needs (both retail and institutional segments) and the competition landscape

• Proficient in transforming large data sets into actionable insights

• Ability to prioritize and deliver multiple tasks in a deadline-driven environment

• Excellent interpersonal skills, results-oriented, team player

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

jobs.title: Fraud Analyst Officer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Fraud Analyst Officer to join our Middle Office – Anti-Fraud & Financial Crime Center team. The successful candidate will have excellent communication and organizational skills and an acute sense of attention to detail.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Effectively communicate with our internal customer support team in order to resolve dispute requests.

• Process dispute related transactions in the respective internal and card scheme systems (Visa and MasterCard platforms).

• Review of card transaction monitoring alerts to flag or identify suspicious activity outside the normal pattern and activity.

• Investigate and take immediate action on alerts, notifications and reporting to always ensure compliance.

• Resolve issues on behalf of card holders in support of dispute resolution processing, compare alternative actions and decide on appropriate approach.

• Respond to requests in relation to transactions.

• Maintain all investigation records and case outcomes.

• Develop and maintain strong working knowledge of all relevant card scheme rules and regulations.

• Explore new ways that can help improve existing fraud strategies.

• Continuously learning and improving on product and job knowledge.

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience in banking operations department.

• Knowledge of Visa and MasterCard dispute rules and regulations is highly preferred and will be considered a strong asset.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal in English and French.

• Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Strong analytical abilities.

• Capability to think out of the box.

• Able to work within a team.

• Able to manage stress and work with high volumes.

SQ1

jobs.title: Product Owner - Institutional & Wealth
jobs.description:
Department Mission - Software Engineering Platforms
 The Software Engineering Platforms department is dedicated to the customer's journey in Swissquote. We define, analyze and make alive the future of client facing solutions offered by Swissquote. We also maintain those applications to always ensure the best client experience in his journey.
 By collaborating closely with product strategy department we also are the bridge between company’s growth strategy and the corresponding solutions put in place, being then the core actors giving concrete life to the vision defined.
 By working hand in hand with the internal departments and the business that they represent we ensure to always move towards clients and stakeholders needs.

Team Mission
 The Institutional and Wealth section designs, develops and maintains passive investment platforms on Web and mobile for retail clients (InvestEasy, 3a easy, Save Easy, and more to come) as well as the whole set of solutions for institutional clients (APIs, SQPro platform, bridges with FX external platforms…)
 You will be part of Institutional and Wealth Conception team , working together with 3 other product owners, a product designer and an offshore business analyst.

The mission of the team is to transform company strategy into feasible solutions and drive the product's evolution together with the software engineering teams. Your team is focusing on all aspects related to Institutional business and Wealth management across all business lines (Forex, securities, crypto).
 Your responsibilities:

• Communicate and manage relationships with stakeholders to deliver the best product

• Define and document business requirements to capture business needs and constraints, and guide the development process

• Define and maintain a product roadmap to provide a clear direction to the Development teams and stakeholders

• Prioritize the product backlog to ensure that the most valuable work is addressed first and maximize ROI

• Analyze and prioritize client feedback for driving continuous improvements and meeting user expectations

• Collaborate with designers to optimize the user experience (e.g A/B testing, mobile & web)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert for the product, support business and development teams by knowledge sharing and mentoring

• Maintain awareness of market and industry trends for better optimization of solution definition

• Provide guidance on the vision to the Development Team and explain requirements

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for business feature references

• Monitor KPIs to perform feature prioritization and enhance data-driven decisions

• Ensure incremental business validation to make sure developed features meet business requirements

• Educational background: Master or Bachelor degree

• You have a deep understanding of securities trading, forex trading a plus

• You have several years of experience as product owner, business analyst or a similar role

• You have several years of experience working with agile software development teams, and a good understanding of product development in a disciplined agile environment

• You have experience working closely with product designers to build end client solutions on web platforms, mobile a plus

• You have a thorough understanding of the product quality aspect, with prior experience of planning and coordinating business validation activities

• You are an excellent communicator and storyteller with different stakeholders, able to face stakeholders as well institutional clients

• You have experience in sharing your business knowledge and mentoring other team members

• Fluent in English

jobs.title: Document Digitization & Records Management Agent
jobs.description:
As a Records Management Agent within our Campus Services department, you will play a key role in the digital transformation of our internal processes. You will be responsible for the digitization, indexing, and classification of physical and electronic documents to ensure their accessibility, compliance, and long-term preservation.
 This position is ideal for someone detail oriented, organized, and motivated by continuous improvement in document workflows.
 Your responsibilities:

• Document digitization — Prepare, scan, and perform quality checks on incoming documents.

• Structured indexing — Assign accurate metadata to ensure fast and reliable retrieval.

• Document classification — Organize digital and physical records according to internal standards.

• Quality control — Verify accuracy, readability, and consistency of digitized files.

• Document workflow management — Contribute to optimizing archiving and information flow processes.

• Internal support — Assist teams with document searches, retrieval, and consultation.

• “Agente en information documentaire CFC / Agent en information documentaire CFC” or equivalent

• At least 2 years of experience in this function or similar

• Comfortable with scanning tools, document management systems and digital environments.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and strict adherence to procedures.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments.

• Proficiency in French and English

jobs.title: Junior Business & Application Support
jobs.description:
After an initial training period covering our banking and trading platforms, Oracle databases, internal Python-based tools, and financial products, you will join our Application & Business Support team and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of Swissquote's production systems.
 Your mission will be to investigate complex business and technical issues, support critical banking and trading operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our internal processes and tools.
 Responsibilities

• Investigate and resolve complex incidents impacting our banking, trading and forex platforms.

• Act as a primary point of contact for internal departments requiring technical and business support.

• Perform root cause analysis on production issues and coordinate with development teams when escalations are required.

• Analyze large datasets and conduct investigations using SQL (Oracle, Postgres).

• Maintain and improve monitoring processes to ensure the reliability of our systems and services.

• Develop automation tools and scripts (Python) to increase operational efficiency and reduce manual workload.

• Produce complex data extractions and analyses for business, legal, compliance, and operational teams.

• Participate in internal reconciliations and database integrity controls to ensure data consistency across platforms.

• Monitor critical production processes and proactively identify anomalies.

• Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for business-critical applications.

• Be open to joining an on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support in the long term.

• Degree in Information Systems (for example Bachelor HES or similar) and a strong interest for IT

• Your skills set include the following: Windows/Unix/Linux environment, SQL and scripting (Python, Bash), Git.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Eager to work on critical systems.

• Interest in financial markets, banking operations, and trading systems.

• Ability to understand both technical systems and business processes.

• Strong communication skills and ability to interact with multiple stakeholders.

• Autonomous, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

• Good knowledge of French and strong working knowledge of English (minimum B2)

SQ2

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
You will join the IT Department’s IT Platform Operations team, whose role is to operate the layer between raw infrastructure and the bank’s corporate-facing services: the application-tier middleware fabric, the Kubernetes control plane, and the user-facing surface of the bank’s Sovereign AI Platform.
 The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in operating Kubernetes-native platform engineering systems at scale, and will lead the integration of open-source AI tooling within a regulated corporate environment while ensuring large language model (LLM) inference scales. Your expertise will help your team deliver the platform on which the bank provides governed access to internal and external AI capabilities — distributed inference, agentic workflows, notebooks, and chatbots — built on top of the GPU and serving substrate provided by the Systems & Storage teams.
 With your team, you will work closely with IT Architects, Observability & Performance Analysts, the Cybersecurity function and the Systems teams to plan and execute the department’s long-term objective of a sovereign AI capability that runs under the bank’s own governance — data sovereignty, content safety, prompt-injection defenses, agentic-workflow audit, and cost control on external API spend — and that is AI Act- and DORA-ready by design.

• Design, deploy and operate distributed LLM inference (LLM-d) on Kubernetes — sizing for throughput, tail latency and GPU utilisation against the serving substrate provided by IT Systems Services (ITSS).

• Operate and harden the user-facing AI surface: the Open WebUI cross-department chatbot, JupyterHub notebooks for data scientists, and the agent catalog (agentregistry).

• Build and operate Agentgateway as the governed routing layer to external providers (Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI GPT API), enforcing traffic policy, rate limiting, cost controls and audit logging.

• Implement content-safety, prompt-injection defense and agentic-workflow audit controls, plus the agent-identity model required for EU AI Act and DORA compliance.

• Operate the Kubernetes control plane — etcd, API server, scheduler and controller-manager — with HA sizing and surge-upgrade discipline; contribute to multi-cluster management for the meshed cross-cluster pattern.

• Define SLOs and instrument the platform for performance and availability; lead incident response across the AI platform and control-plane critical path.

• Automate platform provisioning and configuration through Infrastructure as Code and governed automation (AAP), keeping every deployment repeatable, reviewable and auditable.

• Develop and maintain architecture documentation and operational runbooks, and participate in the 24×7 on-call rotation.

Minimum Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, with at least 3 years operating production Kubernetes and/or machine-learning serving workloads at scale.

• Proven experience managing complex, mission-critical IT environments and contributing to large-scale platform projects.

• Experience in regulated or high-assurance industries such as banking, telco, aviation, pharmaceutics or government.

• Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals, container runtimes, distributed systems, networking and cloud-native security.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, capable of working with multi-functional technical and business teams, along with different levels of management to influence decision making.
 Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with LLM-d or comparable distributed inference / model-serving frameworks (e.g. vLLM, TGI, NVIDIA Triton, Ray Serve, KServe).

• Experience operating JupyterHub, Open WebUI, or similar multi-tenant notebook and chatbot platforms.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-native agentic frameworks (e.g. kagent), AI traffic-routing / gateway layers (e.g. Agentgateway), and agent-registry / catalog patterns.

• Experience integrating and governing external LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT) — routing, rate limiting, cost control and audit.

• Proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, Go, Rust, Java, C++.

• Comfortable with Infrastructure as Code and governed automation tooling (Ansible / AAP, Terraform, etc.); familiarity with event streaming (Apache Kafka) and observability stacks.

SQ2

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
As a Brand Marketing Intern, you will be fully immersed in the dynamic environment of a Brand Team within the finance sector. Working closely with the social media and brand management team, you will contribute to the development of impactful marketing initiatives while gaining hands-on experience in client engagement, campaign coordination, and strategic analysis. This internship offers a unique opportunity to sharpen your creativity, analytical thinking, and project management skills in an international and fast-paced setting.
 In this role, you will:
 For the Social Media part:

• Manage influencer marketing campaigns throughout the internship: develop concepts, identify influencers, coordinate activations, and oversee projects to promote products and services.

• Manage the Swissquote social media community: reply to comments and messages, interact with the community, and engage proactively every day.

• Assist the Social Media Managers with content publishing through the dedicated management platform.

• Create content with Canva and CapCut to support the Social Media Managers in their daily work.

• Conduct social media benchmarking and monitor trends, formats, and best practices.

• Take part in vertical video creation, with the possibility to appear in some videos.
 For the Brand Management part:

• Coordinate and manage entry point product and segment (including but not limited to Themes Trading and Student target audience), ensuring alignment with business and brand objectives.

• Assist in coordinating projects across departments, ensuring alignment and consistency in brand messaging.

• Contribute to creative brainstorming sessions, helping generate innovative ideas for brand initiatives and client activations.

• Play an active role in enhancing client satisfaction by supporting the timely and effective resolution of client inquiries, particularly during campaigns and promotional periods.

• Conduct in-depth competitive and market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and strategic insights.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and international offices to support the seamless execution of marketing activities.

• Oversee and manage the department’s main communication inbox, ensuring prompt, professional, and brand-aligned responses.

• French mother tongue; strong command of English required (Italian and/or German are a plus).

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a university degree in Marketing (HEC, HES, or equivalent). Previous internship experience in marketing is a plus.

• Strong interest in both online and offline marketing, with a curiosity for brand strategy.

• Interest in the banking/finance sector is an advantage.

• Excellent command of PowerPoint and Excel.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and web analytics tools is a plus.

• Creative, proactive, and able to work independently.

• Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to synthesize information effectively.

• Excellent communication skills, detail-oriented, and eager to take initiative.

SQ2

jobs.title: Customer Care Representative - 20%
jobs.description:
Your mission
 Do you love helping people and learning new things? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our Customer Care Representative position. You will be the main link between Yuh and our awesome clients, who use our app to manage their finances and investments. You will answer their questions, solve their problems, and guide them through their financial journey with Yuh.
 Key Responsabilities

• Act as a point of contact for clients, primarily handling written inquiries (chat, email, in-app messaging), and delivering a professional, friendly, and solution-oriented customer experience.

• Provide prompt, accurate, and reliable support related to the Yuh app and banking services, ensuring a high level of service quality.

• Support clients by clearly explaining products, features, and processes in an easy-to-understand and empathetic manner.

• Ensure high client satisfaction by carefully addressing requests, executing client instructions, and resolving issues with professionalism and attention to detail.

• Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience during interactions and contribute ideas to enhance services and processes.

• Accurately document client interactions in internal systems and ensure proper follow-up where required.

• Collaborate closely with the Customer Care team and other departments to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery.

• Comply with internal guidelines, regulatory requirements, and the principles of fair client treatment at all times.

Your Profile

• Currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences (Bachelor or Master), ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field

• Strong interest in banking, fintech, and customer experience

• Excellent written communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset

• Fluent in English; German and-or French is a strong advantage

• Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

• Comfortable using digital tools and learning new systems quickly

This is a part-time job of 20%.

jobs.title: Customer Care Representative
jobs.description:
Your mission
 Do you love helping people and learning new things? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our Customer Care Representative position. You will be the main link between Yuh and our awesome clients, who use our app to manage their finances and investments. You will answer their questions, solve their problems, and guide them through their financial journey with Yuh.
 Key Responsabilities

• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, handling of inbound and outbound phone calls (approximately 70–80% of daily activities), and delivering a consistently professional and positive customer experience.

• Provide accurate support via telephone, ensuring first class service quality. Resolving client inquiries, issues and requests related to the Yuh App in the sectors pay, save and investments.

• Actively guide and support clients, mainly over the phone, through their financial journey, explaining products, features and processes in a clear, empathetic, friendly and compliant manner.

• Ensure the highest levels of client satisfaction by executing client instructions and addressing concerns with friendliness and professionalism, especially in time sensitive or complex situations.

• Accurately document client interactions and outcomes in internal systems, ensuring proper follow-up and transparency across teams. Collaborate closely with other Customer Care Representatives and internal departments to ensure seamless service delivery and contribute insights for platform, service, and process improvements.

• Uphold the principles of fair client treatment, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance at all times.

• Completed apprenticeship (Federal certificate of Competence (Fähigkeitszeungnis / Fachausweis/ Berufsmatura)

• Previous experience in customer satisfaction, preferably in financial services in handling customer enquiries and complaints

• Fluency in English and French depending on your work location. For this position, Italian proficiency is highly recommended (German is a plus).

• A strong interest for financial product and markets, including stocks, ETFs and cryptocurrencies

• Excellent communication – verbal and written – skills

• Familiarity with office software and phone systems

• You are particularly skilled at listening, communicating, showing empathy, and being spersuasive

• You have a proactive and “can do” attitude

• You like working in a team

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Software Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software. If you see yourself as a Craftsman who enjoys designing, brainstorming, reviewing and testing, then this is the right place for you!
 As a Software Engineer on the Platforms Security team, you will develop and maintain software systems focused on Web and Mobile Authentication mecanisms, 2fa and third party integration. Security is at the heart of what we do — you will contribute to building secure, resilient systems that protect user identities, enforce access controls, and uphold the highest standards of data integrity. You will interact with product owners, designers, IT and other software engineers to deliver reliable and high-quality platform solutions.
 What will you do here?

• Actively participate in the development of our security scope by creating efficient and reliable code

• Collaborate closely with product owners and designers to understand requirements, discuss solutions and translate their needs into robust implementations

• Keep yourself up-to-date on cutting-edge technologies — including AI-powered development tools and practices — and actively contribute to the technical direction of the team

• Explore and integrate AI capabilities where relevant to improve platform services, developer productivity or user experience

• Contribute to the design and implementation of secure systems ensuring compliance with KYC regulations and security best practices

• Coordinate and organize product evolution and delivery

• Provide support on the applications to our internal and external users

• Use modern test frameworks to ensure the quality of the applications

• A degree in computer science or equivalent

• Min 5 years of experience in development of production-ready applications

• Experience in Java development and willingness to learn open source frameworks such as Maven, Spring and Hibernate

• Knowledge of RESTful services

• Knowledge of Linux, Docker, Jenkins, Tomcat, Kubernetes, Sonar and Databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Redis)

• Knowledge of Git version control system

• Familiar or willing to work with Kibana and Grafana

• Knowledge of event-driven architectures

• Familiar or willing to work with test-driven development: TestNG, Wiremock, etc.

• Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Experience working in Agile environments

• Good communication skills, team player, rigorous and autonomous

• Familiarity with security standards and protocols (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, PKI, etc.) is a plus

• Fluent in English, French is an asset

• Experience with React or frontend development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript) is a plus

Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior information Security Engineer, you will play a key role in building security and privacy by design in our information systems and products.
 As part of the Information Security Service, you will collaborate with our IT and Software Engineering Departments to design, review and audit security measures across a wide range of products and technologies, and you will contribute to automating security processes and activities. You will be responsible to identify and analyze new risks and vulnerabilities, and to design effective remediation to improve our security posture. You will also contribute to the software engineers security training, fostering a culture of security consciousness among employees and stakeholders.
 Together with the other members of the IT Security team, you will contribute to make our Bank more secure and resilient, and to grow efficiently in an increasingly regulated industry.
 We are looking for a seasoned Information Security professional who can leverage their expertise and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. If you are eager to embrace this challenge, we look forward to receiving your application.

• Provide security advisory and guidelines to software engineering teams to elaborate, enforce and monitor security controls and solutions.

• Perform risk assessments of new projects and support teams in applying mitigation measures.

• Design secure architectures and perform threat modelling.

• Contribute to security automation (SOAR, scripting recurring tasks).

• Review and improve our SDLC security based on known tools and standards (PCI SSD, OWASP, OpenSAMM)

• Contribute to elaborating security reports and dashboards.

• Coordinate with security testing providers and internal teams for penetration tests and vulnerability reports.

• Participate to our internal Red Team activities.

• Advise on technical solutions related to crypto custody services and participate in their elaboration.

• Participate in due diligence process when onboarding a partner or technical solution.

• Operate and maintain HSMs and crypto custody solutions.

• Participate to security incident response activities.

Mandatory

• Minimum 5 years experience as Security Engineer, Architect or similar roles

• Ability to communicate and engage with various departments and teams

• Excellent French and English communication skills, oral and written

• Good command of scripting and programming languages (Python, PowerShell, Java)

• Knowledge of technologies and concepts such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, Cloud, Networking, Windows, Linux

• Solid analytical and critical thinking abilities
 Desired

• Bachelor or Master in Computer Science or similar

• Experience with Kubernetes and Microsoft Azure

• Experience with: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic / Kibana, OpenCTI, Java

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
The CRM team mission
 The team mission is to develop &, maintain Swissquote's CRM and integrate it with our internal IT & software development solutions.

Microsoft based solution was chosen; Dynamics 365 being the latest version live offering the Sales & Marketing (Customer insights) modules.

The team will also soon collaborate with the customer care department by offering a similar Dynamics 365 experience based on in-house developed solutions replicating MS Dynamics - Customer Service - capabilites.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a  Product Engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with a product mindset to build AI-powered solutions for our customers and employees.

You will design, develop, and deploy AI-native applications, owning the full lifecycle from backend services and model integration to user experience and performance monitoring. Working closely with Customer Care and Sales teams Business teams, you will help transform our CRM solution through practical and reliable inhouse AI solutions.
 Responsibilities

• Build and maintain AI generated-code applications using coding agents such as ClaudeCode

• Integrate with other components of Swissquote CRM ecosystem such as MS Dynamics 365, Genesys, Micro Service architecture into production environments.

• Collaborate with Data Scientists and business stakeholders to deliver impactful and straight to the point solutions.

• Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, and governance requirements expected in a regulated financial environment.

• Experience developing production-grade software applications.

• Strong programming skills in Java and modern software development frameworks, understanding of .Net environment is a plus.

• Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI application development.

• Strong problem-solving skills and product-oriented thinking.

• Experience in CRM applications is a strong advantage

• Experience in banking, financial services, or fintech is a plus.
